title: Cell Lysis Without Detergents
author: Teesha C Luehr
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.y4ffytn
materials: Proceed to the STAGE tip protocol

steps.title: Culture HeLa cells
steps.instruction: Grow HeLa cells in Dulbecco's Modified Eagle's Medium (DMEM) supplemented with 10 % fetal bovine serum, 20 mM glutamine, and 1 % PenStrep; aim for 2 × 10⁷ cells per sample (one 15 cm dish or 2–3 × 10 cm dishes, each 10 cm dish yields ~8.8 × 10⁶ cells).

steps.title: Harvest and wash cells
steps.instruction: Using a 15 mL conical tube, pellet the cells at 300 g for 5 min, discard supernatant, wash the pellet with 10 mL cold PBS, then re‑pellet at 300 g for 5 min.

steps.title: Store cell pellet
steps.instruction: Keep the cell pellet on ice if lysing immediately; otherwise freeze at –80 °C until use.

steps.title: Prepare 2 M Tris stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1.211 g Tris‑base and 243 µL concentrated HCl (37 %) in Milli‑Q water to a final volume of 5 mL (pH 8.5). The stock is kept in a bench‑top conical tube; Tris‑base is located in NCE 438 chemical room (top‑right double shelf).

steps.title: Prepare 100 mM TCEP stock
steps.instruction: Add 250.187 mg tris(2‑carboxyethyl)phosphine (TCEP) to 10 mL Milli‑Q water; aliquot 405 µL (100 mM) and store at –20 °C (freezer door NCE 436, top shelf).

steps.title: Prepare 400 mM CAA stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve 374.04 mg 2‑chloroacetamide (CAA) in 10 mL Milli‑Q water; aliquot 405 µL (400 mM) and store at –20 °C (freezer door NCE 438, “C” shelf).

steps.title: Prepare 50 mM NH4HCO₃ buffer
steps.instruction: Add 197.4 mg ammonium bicarbonate to 50 mL Milli‑Q water (final 50 mM). Scale volume as needed; up to 15 mL will be used per replicate.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in ice‑cold water
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 1.5 mL ice‑cold Milli‑Q water in a 15 mL conical tube (the same tube will be used for all downstream steps).

steps.title: Add Tris to reach 100 mM
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of the 2 M Tris stock to the suspension to obtain a final Tris concentration of 100 mM.

steps.title: Add TFE for hypotonic lysis
steps.instruction: Add 1.5 mL trifluoroethanol (TFE) to the sample (1:1 water‑TFE) in the fume hood; TFE is stored in the NCE 435 flammable cabinet. Work quickly as TFE evaporates rapidly.

steps.title: Cool on ice
steps.instruction: Place the tube on ice for 10 min.

steps.title: Vortex 1 min
steps.instruction: Vortex the sample for 1 min to mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Sonicate 2 min
steps.instruction: Sonicate the sample for 2 min using a Branson Digital Sonifier 250 at 30 % amplitude in pulse mode (0.2 s on, 0.8 s off) with the tapered micro‑tip probe. Alternatively, use a bench‑top water‑bath sonicator for 10 min.

steps.title: Add TCEP to 10 mM
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL of the 100 mM TCEP stock to reach a final TCEP concentration of 10 mM.

steps.title: Add CAA to 40 mM
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL of the 400 mM CAA stock to reach a final CAA concentration of 40 mM.

steps.title: Heat at 95 °C for 10 min
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube in a heating block at 95 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Dilute to 15 mL with 50 mM NaHCO₃
steps.instruction: Dilute the sample with 50 mM sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO₃) to a final volume of 15 mL (this also dilutes the TFE).

steps.title: Measure protein concentration
steps.instruction: Determine protein concentration using a NanoDrop spectrophotometer (SCOPES A205 Protein assay).

steps.title: Add calculated LysC
steps.instruction: Calculate LysC amount (1 µg LysC per 100 µg protein) and add the calculated volume; LysC stock is stored at –80 °C.

steps.title: Digest with LysC 2 h at 37 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the LysC‑treated sample for 2 h at 37 °C in a digestion incubator.

steps.title: Add calculated trypsin
steps.instruction: Calculate trypsin amount (1 µg trypsin per 100 µg protein) and add the calculated volume; trypsin is stored at –20 °C (NCE 435 freezer, bottom shelf).

steps.title: Digest 16 h at 37 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the sample for a minimum of 16 h at 37 °C in the digestion incubator.

steps.title: Vortex three times 5 s
steps.instruction: Vortex the tube for 5 seconds, repeat this vortex step three times.

steps.title: Optional second trypsin digestion
steps.instruction: If desired, calculate a second trypsin addition (same 1 µg per 100 µg protein ratio), add trypsin, and incubate for 5 h at 37 °C.

steps.title: Transfer desired protein amount to new tube
steps.instruction: Calculate the total protein amount needed for downstream work (final peptide concentration will be ~10‑50 % of this protein amount), transfer that volume to a new tube; if the volume is small, use a 2 mL low‑bind tube.
